chunks: A person in the state of ihram scratches his head, and one louse or two lice fall off. He said: “There is nothing upon him, and he does not return it.”
He said: “How should the person in ihram scratch?” He said: “With his nails, so long as he does not draw blood and does not cut his hair.”

key_terms.اَلْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or ‘umrah
key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no liability or penalty upon him

ai.seo_question: Can a person in ihram scratch their head if lice fall off?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim who scratches his head and causes one or two lice to fall. It states that there is no penalty in such a case, and clarifies that scratching is allowed as long as it does not cause bleeding or remove hair.
